tasks.subject: Task 1: Create Wok.SourceOrigin leaf module
tasks.description:
**Goal:** Leaf module hosting `Origin` so `Wok.Loader` and `Wok.TypeChecking.Infer` can both depend on it without a cyclic import.

**Files:** Create `src/Wok/SourceOrigin.hs`; Modify `wok.cabal`, `test/Spec.hs` (smoke test).

**Verify:** `cabal test --test-options="-p sourceOrigin"`

```json:metadata
{"files": ["src/Wok/SourceOrigin.hs", "wok.cabal", "test/Spec.hs"], "verifyCommand": "cabal test --test-options=\"-p sourceOrigin\"", "acceptanceCriteria": ["Origin ADT exported", "originPath round-trips", "no transitive deps", "smoke test passes"]}
```

tasks.subject: Task 2: Add overlayEnvs + EnvNs to Wok.TypeChecking.Env
tasks.description:
**Goal:** Left-biased Env merge combinator surfacing per-namespace collisions; used by the loader to compose imports.

**Files:** Modify `src/Wok/TypeChecking/Env.hs`, `test/Spec.hs`.

**Verify:** `cabal test --test-options="-p envOverlay"`

```json:metadata
{"files": ["src/Wok/TypeChecking/Env.hs", "test/Spec.hs"], "verifyCommand": "cabal test --test-options=\"-p envOverlay\"", "acceptanceCriteria": ["EnvNs exported", "overlayEnvs disjoint union works", "all three namespace collisions detected", "multi-namespace collisions all reported"]}
```

tasks.subject: Task 3: Add overlayFixities + reorderModuleWith to Wok.Reordering
tasks.description:
**Goal:** Split fixity-table construction from expression reordering so the loader can seed reordering with an external (merged-from-imports) fixity table.

**Files:** Modify `src/Wok/Reordering.hs`, `test/Spec.hs`.

**Verify:** `cabal test --test-options="-p Wok.Reordering"`

```json:metadata
{"files": ["src/Wok/Reordering.hs", "test/Spec.hs"], "verifyCommand": "cabal test --test-options=\"-p Wok.Reordering\"", "acceptanceCriteria": ["overlayFixities + emptyFixityTable + reorderModuleWith exported", "RedeclaredOp on conflict", "reorderModule unchanged externally", "three new tests pass"]}
```

tasks.subject: Task 4: Rename skolemize -> freezeSig
tasks.description:
**Goal:** Replace skolem jargon. Function rename + Types.hs comment + syntax.md reword. Rigid constructor stays.

**Files:** Modify `src/Wok/TypeChecking/Infer.hs`, `Types.hs`, `syntax.md`.

**Verify:** `cabal test 2>&1 | tail -5` + `grep -RIn "skolem\|Skolem" src app syntax.md` empty.

```json:metadata
{"files": ["src/Wok/TypeChecking/Infer.hs", "src/Wok/TypeChecking/Types.hs", "syntax.md"], "verifyCommand": "cabal test", "acceptanceCriteria": ["no skolem references remain", "freezeSig docstring uses double example", "all tests pass"]}
```

tasks.subject: Task 5: Add modPathText + modPathPos; remove modPathHead
tasks.description:
**Goal:** Replace `modPathHead` (errors on MPDot) with `modPathText` (flattens MPDot to dotted Text) + `modPathPos` (first ConId position for error reporting).

**Files:** Modify `src/Wok/TypeChecking/Infer.hs`, `test/Spec.hs`.

**Verify:** `cabal test --test-options="-p modPath"`

```json:metadata
{"files": ["src/Wok/TypeChecking/Infer.hs", "test/Spec.hs"], "verifyCommand": "cabal test --test-options=\"-p modPath\"", "acceptanceCriteria": ["modPathText flattens any depth", "modPathPos returns leftmost pos", "modPathHead removed", "callers updated", "tests pass"]}
```

tasks.subject: Task 6: Warning channel + bodyless sig support + inferProgramWith
tasks.description:
**Goal:** Add Warning ADT, fix bodyless sig silent-drop bug, add `inferProgramWith :: Env -> Origin -> Module -> Either TypeError (Env, [TypedDecl], [Warning])`. Existing `inferProgram` retained as wrapper.

**Files:** Modify `src/Wok/TypeChecking/Infer.hs`, `Wok.TypeChecking.hs`, `test/Spec.hs`.

**Verify:** `cabal test --test-options="-p bodyless"`

**Depends on:** Task 1 (Origin), Task 4 (freezeSig name).

```json:metadata
{"files": ["src/Wok/TypeChecking/Infer.hs", "src/Wok/TypeChecking.hs", "test/Spec.hs"], "verifyCommand": "cabal test --test-options=\"-p bodyless\"", "acceptanceCriteria": ["Warning ADT exported", "inferProgramWith threading Env+Origin+warnings", "back-compat inferProgram works", "bodyless sigs reach env verbatim", "UserFile emits warnings; Embedded silent", "multi-name handles per-name"]}
```

tasks.subject: Task 7: Create Wok.Prelude with placeholder embedded source
tasks.description:
**Goal:** Embedding plumbing. `Wok.Prelude` exposes `preludeName` + `preludeSource` via file-embed. Real content lands at cutover.

**Files:** Create `prelude/Std/Base.wok`, `src/Wok/Prelude.hs`; Modify `wok.cabal`, `test/Spec.hs`.

**Verify:** `cabal test --test-options="-p prelude"`

```json:metadata
{"files": ["prelude/Std/Base.wok", "src/Wok/Prelude.hs", "wok.cabal", "test/Spec.hs"], "verifyCommand": "cabal test --test-options=\"-p prelude\"", "acceptanceCriteria": ["preludeName is Std.Base", "preludeSource embedded via file-embed", "cabal exposes Wok.Prelude with file-embed dep", "smoke tests pass"]}
```

tasks.subject: Task 8: Create Wok.Loader (module map, dep graph, topo sort)
tasks.description:
**Goal:** `loadProgram :: FilePath -> [FilePath] -> IO (Either LoaderError [LoadedModule])`. Embeds Std.Base; parses + collects fixities; validates headers; builds dep graph; topo-sorts.

**Files:** Create `src/Wok/Loader.hs`, `test/loader-fixtures/`; Modify `wok.cabal`, `test/Spec.hs`.

**Verify:** `cabal test --test-options="-p loader"`

**Depends on:** Task 1 (Origin), Task 3 (FixityTable ops), Task 5 (modPathText), Task 7 (preludeSource).

```json:metadata
{"files": ["src/Wok/Loader.hs", "wok.cabal", "test/loader-fixtures/", "test/Spec.hs"], "verifyCommand": "cabal test --test-options=\"-p loader\"", "acceptanceCriteria": ["loadProgram signature exact", "Std.Base first in topo order", "10 LoaderError variants", "7 fixture tests pass"]}
```

tasks.subject: Task 9: Rename TcInt -> TcU64 across code and test fixtures
tasks.description:
**Goal:** Mechanical rename. Constructor + Builtins env key + every test fixture/golden. No behaviour change.

**Files:** Modify `src/Wok/TypeChecking/Types.hs`, `Builtins.hs`, `Infer.hs`; every `test/typecheck-*`; `test/Spec.hs`.

**Verify:** `cabal test 2>&1 | tail -10` + greps empty.

```json:metadata
{"files": ["src/Wok/TypeChecking/Types.hs", "src/Wok/TypeChecking/Builtins.hs", "src/Wok/TypeChecking/Infer.hs", "test/typecheck-examples/", "test/typecheck-golden/", "test/typecheck-fail-examples/", "test/typecheck-fail-golden/", "test/Spec.hs"], "verifyCommand": "cabal test", "acceptanceCriteria": ["no TcInt references", "no surface Int in fixtures", "all tests pass"]}
```

tasks.subject: Task 10: Cutover — populate Std.Base, shrink Builtins, rewrite Main, migrate fixtures
tasks.description:
**Goal:** The atomic switch. Populate Std.Base; shrink Builtins to irreducible pre-env; rewrite Main with CLI + Loader pipeline; switch test harness to Loader; migrate every typecheck fixture to `module Main; import Std.Base` + Option/Result/[]/u64.

**Files:** Modify `prelude/Std/Base.wok`, `Builtins.hs`, `Infer.hs`, `app/Main.hs`, `test/Spec.hs`, all `test/typecheck-*`.

**Verify:** `cabal test 2>&1 | tail -20`

**Depends on:** Tasks 1-9 (all foundations + TcInt rename).

```json:metadata
{"files": ["prelude/Std/Base.wok", "src/Wok/TypeChecking/Builtins.hs", "src/Wok/TypeChecking/Infer.hs", "app/Main.hs", "test/Spec.hs", "test/typecheck-examples/", "test/typecheck-fail-examples/", "test/typecheck-golden/", "test/typecheck-fail-golden/"], "verifyCommand": "cabal test", "acceptanceCriteria": ["Std.Base populated", "Builtins shrunk to irreducible", "Main CLI + Loader pipeline working", "harness routes through Loader", "all 18 fixture goldens pass migration"]}
```

tasks.description:
